The collection loop hops into gen-2 workspaces with the `analytics` SSH certificate the connector's refresh cron stores in the shared `ssh-management-certs` Modal Dict, and only into gen-1 workspaces with the pool key (imbue-ai/mngr-internal#850). A gen-2 workspace is skipped (counted as `workspaces_skipped_no_certificate`) while no fresh certificate is stored, never hopped with a static key.
